title: OpenUSD (OUSD) on Aave Tempo Assessments
headline: Low-information proposal: a thread that collects risk and technical assessments of OpenUSD (OUSD) on Aave Tempo.
summary: The thread is the single home for assessments of OpenUSD (OUSD) on Aave Tempo: the pre-listing risk assessment under the Aave Risk Framework, the pre-listing technical assessment under the Technical Asset Listing Framework, and later monitoring reports and re-evaluations. Parameters for OUSD will be provided once the conditions set out in the assessment are met. The opening post contains no assessment content itself.
